title: Beyond plateletcrit and MPV/count ratio: a cross-survey test of log-scale platelet size–count coupling
abstract: Adding a log(MPV) × log(platelet count) interaction to flexible conventional indices changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.175636 to 0.175682 (delta +0.000046; approximate joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000045,+0.000287]); incremental improvement was not established under the registered criterion. Source: NHANES III; target: separately recruited NHANES2017–2018. Additive spline baselines include plateletcrit and MPV/count ratio. An exploratory functional-representation test on previously explored surveys, not untouched confirmation or a new biomarker.
